title: Information Percolation and cutoff for Potts Glauber Dynamics
summary: We prove cutoff with an $O(1)$ window for the continuous-time heat-bath Glauber dynamics of the ferromagnetic $q$-state Potts model on the discrete torus $Λ_n=(\mathbb Z/n\mathbb Z)^d$ at sufficiently high temperature. More precisely, for every fixed $d\ge2$ and $q\ge3$, there exists $β_0=β_0(d,q)>0$ such that, for $0<β<β_0$, the cutoff occurs in an optimal $O(1)$ window centered at \[ t_\star=t_\star^{(n)}:=\frac{1}{2\mathfrak{r}}\log |Λ_n|, \] where $\mathfrak{r}\in(0,1)$ is the exact exponential decay rate of the one-site color bias.
